stopping_application: Diagnostic only. Run the complete fixed budget per seed; no online early stopping or tolerance adjustment from scores.

selection.source: Pooled feasible nondominated calibration archive from both final seed prefixes.
selection.baseline: Keep the original nominal generalized candidate as a comparison, even if it becomes dominated.
selection.balanced: Existing Pareto-range-scaled distance to calibration ideal, with deterministic objective and pooled-ID tie breaking.
selection.validation_use: Descriptive held-out evaluation after pooled representative identities and vectors are written and hashed; never used to rank or change them.

budget_interpretation: A small feasibility and progress pilot; neither a guaranteed adequate budget nor global convergence evidence.
optimization_scope: Only the 72 monthly targets. Physics, quarantine, mean-volume convention, signed-net interpretation, inflow scale and provisional initialization remain fixed.
